S1_baseline_is_bad.gate: baseline misses MORE than 40% of the sealed set
S1_baseline_is_bad.note_if_falsified: the spot check was unrepresentative and this module is unnecessary

S2_revision_transfers.gate: revised lexicon misses FEWER than 20% of the sealed set
still_missed: Wear gloves when handling the concentrate; it burns on contact.

S3_precision_holds.gate: at most 10% of the control set fires
S3_precision_holds.why_it_matters: a warning that appears on everything is a warning nobody reads

S4_overfitting_check.reading: the revision generalises: the sealed set is no worse than the set it was written against

honest_notes: A warning firing means 'this touches a domain where structure is not safety'. It says nothing about whether the content is correct or dangerous.
This is word matching, not comprehension. It will miss any phrasing nobody thought of; the sealed miss rate is a floor on that, not a ceiling.
The corpus was written by one author for this test. Real evaluation needs text people actually pasted, and that has not been collected.
This does not make the tool safe to rely on for health decisions. It makes the tool more likely to say so. Those are different things.
